# Steinberg ASIO SDK interface headers

The Windows Standalone ASIO backend uses these unmodified Steinberg interface
headers under the GPLv3 option in [LICENSE.txt](../../../licenses/Steinberg-ASIO-SDK.txt).

The headers and license were taken from JUCE's ASIO SDK bundle at commit
`654bdbc7a9db0dae90849b44abe91f339e9f0768`. The blob hashes are listed below.

| File | Git blob SHA-1 |
| --- | --- |
| `LICENSE.txt` | `84abc282f0b24f827304825dc150e01b0d16f497` |
| `asio.h` | `75d48dcfbef5715e59c0dffbfca72c0511918d06` |
| `asiosys.h` | `335a3607e1bf13df40a06bc81427807bfcf15fcf` |
| `iasiodrv.h` | `4721b9ad039701daefb1ad505ff45ffcabfa142f` |

[Upstream ASIO SDK files](https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/tree/654bdbc7a9db0dae90849b44abe91f339e9f0768/modules/juce_audio_devices/native/asio)
